options.name: --check
options.description:
List files that would change without modifying them
Exit with non-zero if format or syntactic error found

options.name: --loc
options.description:
List members with lines of code greater than or equal to
Blank and readability adjustment lines are excluded
Multiline string literals are collapsed to 1

options.name: --after
options.description:
Format with `JetBrains.ReSharper.GlobalTools` (folder only)
--rm-comments S C     Remove comments that contain either (disabled by default)
S = Number of semicolons (>= 0)
C = Number of commas     (>= 0)
Zero to remove all source code comments

options.name: --config
options.description: Show resolved config and file paths

options.name: --discover
options.description: Preview discovered and ignored files and folders
